name: kuaishou-user-search
doc: people search / author discovery (capability B UserSearch). Evidence: corpus /rest/v/search/user POST body {keyword, pcursor, searchSessionId} -> {result, pcursor, host-name, searchSessionId, users[30x{user_id, user_name, user_text, headurl, verified, isFollowing, livingInfo{living}}]}; oracle probe: 30 users/page, deterministic across repeat calls, cursor window bounded. Termination discipline: the last cursor can rewind to "1" — the engine's user_search atom dedupes by user_id and stops on a page with no new users (fetchPagesDedup), so the pcursor loop is declared has_more-on-pcursor like the other ks faces. dy (query/user) and xhs (onebox) equivalents are not implemented on the synth oracle — ks-first.
